# EnderDocs

> Welcome to the Documentation from Endkind

- [EnderDocs](https://docs.endkind.net/index.md): EnderDocs
- [EnderCliTools](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/index.md): EnderCliTools is a lightweight collection of CLI utilities that make working in the terminal faster and more convenient.

## EnderCliTools

- [dps](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/dps.md): Pretty replacement for docker ps - displays Docker containers in a nicely formatted table
- [dcps](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/dcps.md): Pretty replacement for docker compose ps - displays Docker Compose services in a nicely formatted table

### Config

- [Config](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/config/index.md): Configuration management for EnderCliTools - manage settings and preferences
- [Get](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/config/get.md): Get configuration options for EnderCliTools
- [Reset](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/config/reset.md): Reset configuration options for EnderCliTools
- [Set](https://docs.endkind.net/enderclitools/config/set.md): Set configuration options for EnderCliTools
